notes:
Fixes: GSTR-1 portal tile-click bug, old-password decrypt crash, a genuine Tally crash from invalid AIS dates in TDS booking, and a second Tally crash in the shared ledger-dropdown fetch (Opening Balance + GST fields together were crashing TallyPrime). TDS booking now verifies each voucher actually landed in Tally instead of trusting a false success.

New: portal download progress banner + notifications with a live snapshot viewer; Bank-Tally Booking unresolved-ledger review with bulk ledger creation; an Audit Readiness Checklist (Companies Act pre-audit) available inside Audit Engagements and as a standalone Home-page Quick Action; Journal Entry is now Journal / Voucher Import with a Voucher Type picker (Journal, Payment, Receipt, Contra, Sales, Purchase) for manual entry and Excel upload.
